name: Drain the yard
objective: Stay beside the captured yard while its energy is drawn off: three minutes.
brief: Marines hold the {sector_owner_name} yard here for now. Bring your ship beside it and stay while its stores of energy are drawn off; the {sector_owner_name} will come to take it back.

objectives.text: Reach the yard and hold it until drained
